title: Babtist Camp and Conference Center

services.name: Goodall Cabin
services.desc: Each of our four villages is comprised of four cabins in a circle. Three of the cabins sleep 20 people in three rooms. The cabins also have a central common area ideal for small group gatherings. The fourth cabin in each village is a modern bathhouse with hot and cold running

services.name: Sailing Camp
services.desc: The week is perfect for active 6-10 graders who enjoy the sun and are strong swimmers. Campers will have plenty of time to experience the benefits of small group fellowship as well as learning the skills of sailing. Initial sailing instruction and practice begins on our own lake and moves to Round Valley reservoir

blurb: Baptist Camp and Conference Center is a 110-acre hideaway located in Lebanon, NJ. We are owned and operated by the American Baptist Churches of New Jersey. Camp Lebanon, a favorite site for campers since 1949, is an ideal retreat or conference center for your church, school or non-profit organization.
